settings.title: Product details
settings.content: A vertical bar pendant approximately 35 mm by 5 mm, offered in four finishes with variants for one, two, three, or four engraved sides.

settings.title: How engraving works
settings.content: 1. Pick the finish and number of engraved sides. 2. Enter up to 15 characters on each active side and inspect every surface in the live preview. 3. We engrave only the active sides submitted with your order.
